name: Choosing A Career
overview: Scripture teaches that choosing a career should be grounded in a deep commitment to God's Word and guidance. By meditating on Scripture day and night, believers are promised success and wisdom in their endeavors (Joshua 1:8). Trusting the Lord wholeheartedly and acknowledging Him in all decisions ensures He will direct their paths (Proverbs 3:5-6). Delight in the Lord brings alignment with His desires, and His instruction provides clear guidance for the way to go (Psalms 32:8, 37:4). Furthermore, avoiding ungodly counsel preserves a righteous course in life (Psalms 1:1).
